name: vacancy_report
description: Vacant units with days vacant, market rent and UnitID (built-in Vacancy report). Ends with a reconciliation against vacant_units (the physical definition): units that differ are listed with the reason.
use: Vacant units, days vacant, market rent

property.description: Property name/nickname/ID, comma-separated for several; empty = all

headline: {count} vacant units per the Vacancy report as of {as_of}; total market rent {sum$:market_rent}. UnitID included; see the Reconciliation lines for units that differ from vacant_units.

reconcile.definition: physically vacant = nobody living in the unit today; reserved or held units are vacant and flagged; active properties, no parking/other rentables
reconcile.why_other: the built-in report does not list it
reconcile.why_mine: report lists it but vacant_units excludes it (inactive property or other rentable item)
